title: Cursor hero
description: A quiet, left-aligned opening on paper: a small two-line 26px statement, an ink pill and a pale grey pill under it, then one big 720px-tall media frame across the full content width (a painted backdrop with the product on it in the original). On phones only the ink pill shows, with its own shorter label.
notes: the media frame is 720px tall at every width (not window-sized), cropped like object-fit: cover
the empty slot is a soft glow-to-muted wash
